accueilPro.titre: Your shop, online, without a cumbersome middleman
accueilPro.intro: Catalogue, orders and delivery in a single tool. Your customers order without creating an account, your couriers follow the run live.
accueilPro.clientsTexte: A clear storefront per shop, one basket per shop, and ordering possible without an account.
accueilPro.commercantsTexte: Catalogue, opening hours per service, delivery zones set on a map, and tracking of every order.
accueilPro.livreursTexte: An application reviewed once, then runs offered to the nearest available courier, with calculated pay.
accueilPro.chauffeursTexte: Passenger transport is coming soon. Drivers, sign up to be among the first.
accueilPro.stat2: pages already built on the site
accueilPro.etape1: They browse the shops, check the menu and order, with or without an account.
accueilPro.etape2: The order arrives live; they follow it until it is handed to the courier.
